# SleepLab Baby

SleepLab Baby is an evidence-based guide to baby and toddler sleep products: white noise machines, sleep sacks, blackout curtains, baby monitors, sleep-training books and toddler wake-up lamps.

Every recommendation is checked against peer-reviewed sleep research and safe-sleep (SIDS) guidelines before it is published. Products we cannot defend are cut, regardless of affiliate status.

## Facts about this site

- Topic: baby and toddler sleep products
- Audience: new and expecting parents, primarily Australia and the US
- Method: research-first, evaluation-based, hard narrowing
- Last updated: 2026-08-15
